meta.purpose: THE consolidated plan: everything pending from the original idea (2026-07-08 dictation) plus every add-on decided along the way, in one ordered queue. BASE44_APP_SPEC.json stays the static design index; PROGRESS.md stays the append-only ledger and wins on what-happened conflicts. v2 supersedes v1: Slice 6.5 is now IN FLIGHT (4 approved passes), Slice 7 is BUILT pending the Meshy provider swap, and the original-idea leftovers are queued explicitly.
meta.how_to_use: CONTINUOUS MODE (owner-enabled 2026-07-10). On 'RUN THE PLAN': execute EVERY work_queue item with actor 'base44' whose blocking list is clear, in order, one after another WITHOUT waiting for per-item approval. Per item: load the specialists named in its 'specialists' field IN FULL before building (a build without its specialists loaded is out of contract); run per PROTOCOL steps 2-7; at item end post the evidence (acceptance PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED + screenshots where visual), append PROGRESS.md, COMMIT/PUSH to GitHub (sync discipline: unsynced = unfinished), then take the next clear item. STOP only for: (a) an owner gate or an actor:'owner' blocker, (b) a specialist escalation_trigger, (c) the 2-failed-fix rule, (d) queue empty. When blocked, report what is blocked on whom and HALT that branch - other clear items may still proceed. Skip actor 'owner'/'codex' items silently.
